## Reply Intelligence — Trigger A (multichannel + Sumble tier + propose-time)
Reply (email/LinkedIn/WhatsApp) → Claude triage → if positive: Sumble account tier → propose a time matched to what the prospect asked → write signals+tier to the deal → Claude draft → **assemble the Slack approval-card payload**.

Card payload = reply · draft · proposed time (or "none → manual") · channel · account tier (rpa_signal+stack) · MEDDPICC. The Slack render + [Accept & send] [Edit→lemlist] buttons attach next (needs Slack app token).

## Reply Intelligence — Slack interactivity handler
Slack button → parse → **ACCEPT**: create HubSpot meeting (→ morning-of) + associate to deal + lemlist channel-aware send + ✅ react on the card + threaded confirmation. **EDIT**: ✏️ react + threaded "handling in lemlist".

The original card stays put; state shows as a reaction + an in-thread reply. Webhook = Slack Interactivity Request URL.

## Reply Intelligence — Morning-of scheduler (Trigger B clock)
Daily 07:00 (+ a test webhook) → find HubSpot meetings starting TODAY → get the associated deal → POST its dealId to the Trigger B webhook → Sumble+Exa brief → Slack.

This is the time-trigger that makes Trigger B fire only for meetings that actually happen. Meetings are created by the Slack [Accept] handler.

## Reply Intelligence — Trigger B (Sumble account intelligence + native Exa)
POST {dealId} → HubSpot deal → resolve domain → **Sumble enrich** (automation/RPA stack + hiring) → score RPA signal → Claude 3 Exa queries → native Exa ×3 → Claude brief (leads with the automation stack) → write brief + automation_stack + rpa_signal to the deal.

For Duvo: Sumble surfaces the post-RPA-disillusionment signal with hard numbers (e.g. Ahold = Automation Anywhere + Blue Prism + UiPath, 14 AA job posts). All keys in encrypted creds.

# 🧠 Reply Intelligence System — 4 triggers, 1 workflow
Human-in-the-loop reply automation for outbound. Drafts are **never auto-sent** — the AE approves in Slack.

**A) Reply received** *(webhook)* → Claude triage (7 paths) → Sumble account tier → propose time → Claude draft → Slack approval card
**H) Slack action** *(button)* → Accept = HubSpot meeting + lemlist channel-aware send + ✅ react + thread confirm · Edit = ✏️ hand to lemlist
**S) Morning scheduler** *(07:00 cron)* → find today's meetings → fire Trigger B per deal
**B) Pre-meeting brief** → Sumble + Exa research → Claude brief → HubSpot + Slack

Every external call carries its **native credential** (Anthropic · HubSpot · lemlist · Slack · Sumble · Exa).
HubSpot *meetings* & lemlist *inbox* have no native node → credentialed HTTP by necessity. Exa = native community node.
